description: This PHP source file defines the 'LoginLog' entity class within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It models a login event record, including properties like user ID, username, user role, and login time, with ORM mappings for database persistence.

classes.name: LoginLog
classes.description: An ORM-mapped entity class representing a user login event, storing details such as user ID, username, role, and login timestamp.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user who logged in.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID for the login record.

methods.name: getUserName
methods.description: Returns the username associated with the login.

methods.name: setUserName
methods.description: Sets the username for the login record.

methods.name: getUserRoleName
methods.description: Returns the name of the user's role.

methods.name: setUserRoleName
methods.description: Sets the role name for the login record.
